heading: Healing Art and Earth Wisdom for Young Minds
intro: Our incursions invite the sanctuary of the Australian bush into schools and community centers. Through immersive workshops, we guide children in the meditative craft of fiber weaving and ecological storytelling. By engaging with natural materials, students cultivate a deep sense of wellbeing, patience, and a lasting connection to the environment around them.
pullQuote: It was just what our souls needed.
imageAlt: Green fibres being woven on an upright loom
